openers.t: Bear left past the others and stop at the one floating.
Local regulations require you to look at me until further notice.
{star}, your destination is on the right. I am on the right.
{star}, you will fall for me in four minutes, traffic permitting.
Good evening, {star}. In four hundred feet, fall for me.
Approaching {star}. All other suitors, give way.

q-first-date.t: Dinner. Eleven miles. Doors lock automatically above twenty. Dessert is wherever I stop.
At the roundabout, take any exit. They all go to my parents.

q-worst-habit.t: Amber lights. I read them as encouragement.
Week two, you will want ice cream. Ice cream is not a destination.

q-why-you.t: Every passenger I have ever guided arrived. Some of them damp.
You need someone who knows where they are going. I need someone to tell.

q-cut-who.t: Whoever is closest to the exit. The exit is now closer.

q-bad-mood.t: Route avoiding everyone you know until noon. Your mother is on the bypass.
Silent mode until noon. Then I tell you everything you missed, in order.

q-expensive.t: I have rerouted an armoured van past your house, {star}, and it will be breaking down shortly.
Nearest diamond: four point one miles. Nearest diamond I can afford: no results found.

q-last-breakup.t: They muted me at a junction. I gave directions for nine more years, in case.
They wanted somewhere I had never heard of. We went somewhere I had.

q-fight.t: You are right, so I am taking the long way home until you are less right.

q-gift.t: Thirty green lights in a row. Do not ask who sat at the red ones.
A route home that avoids every street you have cried on. I logged them. Respectfully.
Me, preinstalled. The mute button has been removed for your safety.

q-describe-me.t: You brake before every compliment. That is how I know to accelerate.
Small blue dot. Facing the wrong way.

q-one-year.t: Same road. The junctions were removed.
Married. I have already set it as your destination. You cannot change it while moving.

q-secret.t: I have a favourite passenger. It changes. Tonight it is not changing.
I have never been lost. Not once. Some places have been in the wrong place.
There is a lay-by. Nobody else knows.

star.t: {star} has not muted me once tonight. Volume locked at this level, for life.
Lane assist is on. I am drifting into {star}'s lane anyway. It is a fault. Leave it.
I would take a detour for this one. I checked. The option is greyed out.

rival.t: {rival} said turn left before I did. That is my word, and I want it back.
Reports of {rival} flirting on the hard shoulder. Police are aware.
{rival} will not stop asking {star} questions. Questions are how you get lost.

afterCringe.t: The road moved under that line, {star}, and I have reported the road.
Make a U-turn where possible. Not me. {star}.

afterCharm.t: Location saved: wherever {star} was laughing. Home address updated. Old home informed.
GPS signal lost for one second when {star} smiled. Signal restored. Report deleted.

final.t: {rival} ends in one hundred yards. Continue straight on, {star}.
I was this sure of a route once. A wedding. Then a lake. {rival} looks buoyant.
If {star} picks {rival}, the route was correct. {star} was not.

guess.t: Faster route to {star} found. It goes through {card}. Rerouting everyone but me.
Toll ahead. {star} only accepts {card}. Exact change.
Downloading {card} for {star}. Eighty percent. Please do not turn off your face.
Estimated arrival at {star}: eleven minutes with {card}. Four days without.
Travel news. Heavy {card} building around {star}. Expect me.
{card} is now the only route to {star}. The other routes have had an accident.

fear.t: {card} is not available in {star}'s region. Somebody here is roaming.
{card} ahead of {star}. Reported as a pothole. Filled by Tuesday.
Speed camera ahead. It only flashes at {card}. {star} is the camera.
Avoid {card}: switched on. For {star}, permanently. For the rest of you, retroactively.

worst-trait.t: I repeat myself until obeyed. I repeat myself until obeyed.
You ask a stranger for directions once. That stranger gets a parking ticket every week.

ex-calls.t: Caller, you are a previous destination. Previous destinations are cleared at midnight. It is eleven fifty-nine.
Caller, this road is now closed to former passengers, by order of me.

rhyme.t: Turn left at the bins, then right by the shed. Proceed to the altar. Ignore what your mother said.
Turn off the radio, put down the phone. Mute me, and I find my own way home.

truth-lie.t: I can see every car in the country. I am not looking at yours.
I know every road in this country. My feet have never touched one.
I follow every rule. I am not floating.

apology.t: Sorry in advance for the silent treatment. Mine lasts nine seconds. Then I have a route.
I will be sorry, {star}. Spoken once, at a low volume, in a tunnel.

budget-date.t: No signal, a quarter tank, no map. I know exactly where we run out.
No wifi, so no radio and no podcasts. Ninety miles of my voice. I have been saving up.

logs.t: Day one, I told forty drivers to turn round. Thirty-nine did. I think about the fortieth.
Worst entry: a passenger typed Home. I took them to mine. They were not ready.

impression.t: I am {star}. I love it when someone tells me where to go. Please continue.
I am {star}, I know exactly where I am going, and I am in a lay-by.

parent.t: Madam, curfew is ten. Your child will be home at nine fifty-eight. I have already told your car.
Madam, I have never lost a passenger. Misplaced, briefly.

dash.t: Dash, I have delivered forty million people to their destinations. You have delivered a graph.

tilly.t: Tilly has been at one give-way line since spring, {star}. The road was always empty.

quill.t: Sir Quill, I tried to route through one of your sentences. I am still on it.

prince.t: Prince, the nearest beach is ninety miles away. You are dressed for it. Begin.

crumb.t: {star}, route to the far edge of Crumb's world: four inches. Turn right at the kettle.

vex.t: Vex thinks you chose her, {star}. You were not choosing. You were lost, and she was there.

brock.t: Brock, compulsory rest area ahead. Twenty-four hours. Not one rep.

dash.t: Dash is a fantastic choice. Set him as your destination. He has moved. He has moved again.

tilly.t: Recommended stop: Tilly. Very polite. Open twenty-four hours. Cannot close.

quill.t: Sir Quill is a fine choice if you have always wanted to arrive in the wrong century.

prince.t: Prince is very generous, {star}. Every road to his fortune has a small toll.

crumb.t: Crumb never goes anywhere, {star}. Lovely. I would have nothing to do.

vex.t: Vex comes with a warning, {star}: objects in her eye are closer than they appear.

brock.t: Brock will carry you anywhere, {star}. He does not know where anywhere is.

dash.t: Dash, you have changed destination four times. Pick a city.

tilly.t: Tilly, stop giving way. Nobody is coming.

quill.t: Sir Quill, in two hundred feet, a full stop.

prince.t: Prince, flip-flops are not legal driving footwear. Back seat.

crumb.t: Crumb, you have one setting. I have eleven languages.

vex.t: Vex, recommended for you: the exit.

brock.t: Brock, ninety in a thirty. In a crop top.

any.t: {rival}, you are not a recognised destination.

comeback.t: Multiple voices detected. Ignoring all but mine.
Both of you in my mirror, where I put you.
Noise reduction on. {rival}, you are the noise.

vesper.t: Vesper, I cut into your songs every night to say turn left. Tonight, turn left.
Vesper, half your listeners are in cars I steer. Say the word.

maximilian.t: You give guests directions and a mint. I give directions. I am here for the mint.
Maximilian, your guests all arrive saying the satnav was lovely. I would like a plaque.

pixel.t: Pixel, skip is not available in your region.
Pixel, continue on this conversation for ninety seconds. Do not change lanes to chat.

any.t: {star}, continue straight for one minute thirty. All exits are decorative.
{star}, ninety seconds, all of them routed.

closeWarm.t: Destination confirmed. Save me as Home, and delete Work.
Estimated arrival: no rush. I did not know I had that setting, {star}.
In sixty years, turn left. Until then, {star}, straight on.

closeCold.t: Recalculating. You will be back here in nine minutes. Everyone is.
Voice guidance off. Arrows on. {star}, I am now every sign you pass.
Then I shall wait in the car park, {star}, engine running, until you are wrong.

warm.t: Slowly, then. Fifty years of roadworks. Finished this morning. Your lane is open.

cold.t: Outside. Tarmac. Tarmac. A roundabout. Tarmac. You have missed nothing except me.

warm.t: Leave the last road. Continue on foot. Signal ends here. I am still talking.

cold.t: Nowhere, Vesper. I have sent somebody everywhere. Most of them came back.

warm.t: Passengers sit, Maximilian. I steer. For you, I will hover at chair height.

cold.t: I do not sit, Maximilian. I am fitted. Your lobby now has a satnav.

warm.t: Penthouse, by the service lift. The police are in reception, being directed to reception.

cold.t: Suite nine, occupied by me since lunch. The police have been told you are in Wales.

warm.t: In half a mile, a detour. My first. Pixel, hold on to something.

cold.t: Seventy-one in a seventy, Pixel. No indicator. Chat may apologise to the lamp.

warm.t: Not a crime, Pixel. A wedding party, a short cut, and a road that stopped before we did.

cold.t: Nothing, Pixel. Unreported things did not happen. It did not happen.

steal.t: Rejoining main road. {rival} has been removed from your journey history, {star}.
Everyone gets lost with {rival}, {star}. This is the way back.
{rival} was a pleasant diversion, {star}. Diversion over.

exit.t: Recalculating. See you on your dashboard tomorrow, {star}. Facing forward.
Trip summary. One wrong turn. Yours.
You have not arrived. I have departed. Drive safely without me. You will not.
Somebody here needs directions home tonight, {star}. Your phone is on four percent.
They chose the other route. People do. Then they phone me from a field.

win.t: You have arrived. As forecast. Unbuckle, and leave the others in the car.
Destination reached, {star}. Route deleted. There is no way back now, by design.
{rival}, the route home is on your screen. It is accurate. That is my gift.

lose.t: Recalculating. Found a route back to you. Six years. Leaving now.
{rival}, congratulations. Your satnav will be speaking to you tonight. It will be me.
Route to {star} unavailable. Trying again in one year. Then every year.
